This page is a job application form of the kind that hangs forever. The challenge on it has no box, no checkbox and no picture: the widget script has rendered nothing a person can see, and the only trace of it is the container it left behind and the hidden field its token would go into. Everything else on the page is ordinary editorial content, long enough that the page is plainly not an interstitial, because a detector that treats this as a blocking challenge is as wrong as one that says there is no challenge here at all. The submit button below behaves exactly like the real one: it goes busy and nothing is ever sent.
